component.name: Direct3D through Wine
component.summary: Direct3D for hosts whose GPU has no Vulkan 1.3

description.p: Windows XP and Windows 98 machines draw their Direct3D on the host GPU through Vulkan. On a host whose GPU has no Vulkan 1.3, this add-on gives them Wine's Direct3D over OpenGL instead. It is slower, and it is only used when the GPU cannot do better. With a Vulkan 1.3 GPU it is never needed.
